scripts.rename-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join(__dirname,'src','Assets','Portfolio img.jpg');const dest=path.join(__dirname,'src','Assets','portfolio.jpg');try{if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.renameSync(src,dest);console.log('Renamed asset to portfolio.jpg')}else{console.log('No old asset filename found, nothing to rename')}}catch(e){console.error('Failed renaming asset:',e);}"
